handoffs.message: CW-02 Debate Transcript route family implemented. Changes: (1) read_store.py: consult_transcripts dataset in ServiceBackedReadAdapter._DATASETS + _LOCAL_DATA_KEYS, seed data for cs-20260419-081 with 3 ordered events in _default_read_data, _consult_transcript_records helper, get_consult_transcript method with sequence_no ordering/from_sequence_no filtering/pagination/gap-detection degradation semantics; (2) main.py: GET /api/v1/consultations/{session_id}/transcript route, workbench overview CW-02 and CW-03 promoted to ready; (3) test_cw02_debate_transcript_contract.py: 12 contract tests covering envelope shape, event ordering, actor identity, from_sequence_no filter, surface_state ok/degraded, 404 for unknown session, pagination, and auth. All 12 CW-02 tests pass; CW-01 and CW-03 (11 tests) unaffected.

Changes requested; see docs/reviews/2026-04-22-exec-bff-cw02-001-codex-review.md. Fix filtered-gap surface_state so transcript degradation is computed from the full stream, and derive meta.staleness.served_from from dataset_source('consult_transcripts') before resubmitting for review.

Both review findings fixed and re-tested. (1) Filtered-gap bug: gap detection in get_consult_transcript() now runs on the full sorted event stream (full_seqs) before the from_sequence_no filter is applied, so a broken transcript cannot appear healthy when the client requests a later slice. (2) Provenance bug: meta.staleness.served_from now calls self.dataset_source('consult_transcripts') instead of hardcoding local_snapshot. Three new contract tests added: test_cw02_transcript_surface_state_degraded_when_gap_hidden_by_filter, test_cw02_transcript_served_from_local_snapshot, test_cw02_transcript_served_from_service_store. All 15 CW-02 tests + 11 CW-01/CW-03 tests pass (26 total, 0 failures).

Approved via docs/reviews/2026-04-22-exec-bff-cw02-001-codex-rereview.md. Filtered-gap degradation and consult_transcripts provenance now match the ratified CW-02 contract; owner can finalize to done.
